tool_suggestions.title: Inventory Optimization Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard to monitor and manage inventory levels across all store locations.
features: Visualize current vs. ideal stock levels
Receive alerts for low stock items
View restock history and upcoming orders
Filter by store, category, or supplier

tool_suggestions.title: Supplier Management Portal
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a portal for managing supplier information and monitoring purchase orders.
features: View and update supplier contact details
Track purchase order status and history
Analyze payment terms and spending trends

tool_suggestions.title: Employee Access Control Manager
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool to manage employee permissions and roles across stores.
features: Assign and modify employee roles and permissions
Monitor activities related to sensitive operations
Generate audit logs for permission changes
View employee contact and employment details
